sourceScope: Retained V12 replay with4km tree page; no new neural generation or source/IDs mutation. Original fine40m grid stays local and real parent remains authoritative elsewhere.

phases.scope: production fragment C/V kernels with real A8/counts; ratio32 geometry forbidden by certificate, no min(C,V)

coverage.scope: actual production MultiMesh vertex/alpha shaders, only ALBEDO and unshaded replaced for coverage readback. Authored placement, real CC0 product. Top control only; no oblique or physical3D C/V exactness claim.

coverageNotes: Actual MultiMesh high/impostor production vertex, cutout and alpha code; unshaded/white ALBEDO substitutions only for coverage readback. C target from production Canopy.prepare and surface_canopy_target at matching transforms. Error normalized by visible crown envelope, not the mostly empty full160m frame. TOP controls are not oblique or physically exact3D C/V.
limitations: No full fresh navigation/campaign qualification for this experimental flag.

High/impostor common-camera lit BRDF or normal-direction parity was NOT measured. Darker high foliage versus brighter mid imagery remains a possible LOD appearance issue; different-camera images do not isolate its cause.
Oblique source view was whole-view meso phase0, so no native/impostor visibility or parallax qualification.
Five-view impostor has planar depth and discrete view changes.
TOP640 was captured before the final shadow reconstruction floor; visibility C/V is unchanged but final shadow appearance640 is not independently recaptured here.
Default renderer remains legacy; tree asset use is explicit. Shrubs/rocks/debris remain stylized.
Historical negative cases/logs are preserved. No start/end hash observations are invented.
